title: Nine Miles of Nothing
subtitle: 天空气象 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天空气象（自然生态·天空与气象）
meta: 主题语境：天空气象（自然生态·天空与气象）　|　核心词汇：atmosphere　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 atmosphere 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 my grandfather learned that the ① atmosphere is nine miles thick and most of it is nothing, and he said that explained a lot. The ② atmosphere, meaning the air around the earth and not the air in the room, had been there for a long time before anybody counted it; an atmosphere, he said, is the only thing that is everywhere and was discovered last. He said the discovering took nine hundred years.

Every ③ atmosphere in his books had a number and no smell, and he said that was the trouble with science. Their ④ atmosphere — the one in the kitchen on Sundays — was nine parts steam and one part argument; an atmosphere, my grandmother said, is the only thing in a house that everybody notices and nobody can describe. She said the kitchen was the proof.

My mother said the ⑤ atmosphere of the place changed in 1971, meaning the people and not the air. The ⑥ atmosphere, meaning the mood and not the gas, is the only thing that can be ruined by one person saying nothing; an atmosphere, she said, is what is left in a room after everybody has stopped pretending. She said the pretending stopped in June.

By 1974 the  atmosphere had become a subject at school, and my brother came home with nine facts and no sense of wonder. The ⑦ atmosphere he cared about was the one at the top of the hill, where the air is thinner and the talking stops; an atmosphere, my father said, is either a thing you measure or a thing you feel, and the word never tells you which. He said the word should be ashamed of itself.

The  atmosphere I remember is the kitchen on a Sunday in 1968, which I have never been able to explain to anybody. ⑧ Atmosphere, my grandmother said in 1979, is the only thing that is made by everybody and blamed on one person; every atmosphere, she said, is a mood that has agreed to be called a fact. She said the blame is the part people remember.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 大气层；大气（地球周围的气体）
B. n. 大气层（指地球周围的空气，与室内空气相对）
C. n. 大气层（指书里那种：只有数字、没有气味）
D. n. 气氛；氛围（一个具体的氛围）
E. n. 气氛（指那个地方的气氛、人之间的空气）
F. n. 气氛；氛围（抽象：情绪留下的东西）
G. n. 大气层（抽象总称；泛指）
H. n. 气氛；空气（指山顶上那种）

items.q: the atmosphere is nine miles thick
The atmosphere, meaning the air around the earth
The atmosphere, meaning the mood and not the gas

answers.why: atmosphere 意为“大气层”，1962 年祖父得知大气层有九英里厚，而且大部分什么也没有，他说这解释了很多事。
atmosphere 指“地球周围的空气”，与室内空气相对，在有人数它之前它已经存在很久了。
atmosphere 指书里那种大气层：只有一个数字，没有气味，他说这就是科学的毛病。
atmosphere 意为“气氛、氛围”，他们家厨房星期天那种气氛是九分蒸汽加一分争吵。
atmosphere 意为“气氛”，指那个地方人与人之间的空气，母亲说 1971 年那个地方的气氛变了，指的是人而不是空气。
atmosphere 意为“气氛、氛围（抽象）”，指情绪而不是气体，它是唯一能被一个人的沉默毁掉的东西。
atmosphere 意为“空气、氛围”，指山顶上那种：空气更稀薄，说话也停了。
atmosphere 为抽象总称，泛指“大气／氛围这种东西”，祖母说它是唯一由所有人共同制造、却只怪在一个人头上的东西。
